**Coaching note for the player:**

White's rook on d1 is hanging and undefended. Your queen can capture it *with check*—that's a royal fork, the strongest form of the move. When you can take a piece and give check simultaneously, do it immediately. After Qxd1+, White's replies all lose the rook: if Rf1 blocks, you play Qxf1+ and win another rook. Always scan for checks and captures together, especially when they combine.
